intro.text: You stand in the ruins of old code. The hum of the mainframe echoes far away.

hallway.text: You step into a dimly lit hallway, wires dangling from the ceiling. Something moves in the shadows.

sleep_room.text: You lay down on a cold, metallic bed. The system hums lullabies as your vision blurs.

glitch_room.text: A wall of corrupted code pulses before you. Data leaks like smoke into the void.

system_core.text: You enter the core of the system. Everything seems alive. Your choices ripple through it.
